rules.statement: A co-owner is not entitled to build a house on land held in common without the consent of the others, and an injunction may be issued against the offending co-owner to remove the building without proof of irreparable damage.
rules.supporting_quote: ". A co-owner is not entitled to build a house on a land held in common without the consent of the others. An injunction may be issued against the offending co-owner to remove the building without proof of irreparable damage to the party complaining."
